Strong English skills, with the ability to explain test results, risk, and trade-offs to peers and stakeholders. title: Senior Growth Product Manager
description: Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call. Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Growth Product Manager to get customers using Soda faster and on more of their data. About Us Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing. Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo. The Role You'll lead our adoption team, a small group of frontend, full-stack, and AI engineers. The team works on onboarding and activation, on keeping workflows coherent across the product, on customer-facing dashboards, and on AI features that save users work. Most of our roadmap is driven by what customers and prospects ask for. This team's work is driven by adoption metrics, because customers rarely ask for the things that would make them use Soda more. You'll start from a hypothesis, for example that changing a flow will get 20% more data contracts created, ship the change, and check whether it worked. We sell to enterprises, so sample sizes are small and A/B tests rarely reach significance. You'll use product analytics, session replays, and conversations with users, and you'll often have to decide with incomplete data. This is a product role. If most of your growth experience is in paid acquisition or lifecycle email, it's probably the wrong fit. You'll also work closely with our Growth team, which is led by a co-founder, on launches and messaging. What You'll Do Own the adoption metrics for Soda Cloud: time to first verified contract for new accounts, data coverage (datasets with contracts and monitors), weekly active datasets and users, and usage of AI features. You'll define them, make sure we can measure them, and improve them. Own the UX of workflows across the product and keep them coherent for our two kinds of users: data engineers, and business users such as data stewards and governance leads. Find where customers get stuck between signing the contract and running Soda on most of their data, and decide what to fix first. Design and ship onboarding flows that get a new team to first value within days, including self-serve paths for technical teams that want to evaluate Soda on their own. Put AI to work on adoption: decide which steps an agent should do for the user, ship them with the team, and measure whether people keep using them. Work with Growth on launches and product marketing, and with our customer engineers on whatever is blocking rollouts at customers. Hiring Process Application: your CV, plus a short answer about one metric you moved (what it was, what you shipped, what happened, and what didn't work) 15-minute phone screen First interview (60 min): a deep dive into product growth work you've done. Part of it is showing us something you shipped that you'd still be proud to demo. Second interview (60 min): a working session on a real Soda adoption problem Culture fit (45 min) We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly. Requirements You Should Have 5+ years in product, including at least 2 owning growth, activation, onboarding, or adoption in B2B SaaS : you were accountable for a metric for long enough to see whether your changes worked. In your application, tell us which metric it was, where it started and where it ended, what you shipped, and what didn't work. Product craft and taste : you love software and have used a lot of it yourself, so you know what a good product feels like. You keep scope small, work in short cycles with engineers and designers, run your own customer calls, and have well-reasoned opinions about UX. An AI-native way of working and building : you've shipped an AI-powered feature and measured whether people use it, you prototype with coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.), and you're happy to open a small PR yourself for something like a copy change. You do your own analysis : you write SQL, build funnels yourself, and know when a sample is too small to conclude anything. Experience with technical products : you've built for engineers or data teams and are comfortable talking about pipelines, warehouses, and APIs. Clear writing and comfort working async : we're a distributed team across 12+ countries, and most decisions happen in writing, in English. The five years don't all have to be in a PM role. If you were a product engineer or a founder and owned a growth metric, please apply. Good to Have Data quality, data observability, data governance, or data infrastructure experience. Experience with product-led growth at a company that also sells to enterprises. Experience with Shape Up or another fixed-time, variable-scope way of working. Benefits What We Offer Compensation €120,000–140,000/year + equity. Outside Belgium, this is a contractor position. Fully remote (EU-based), with a Belgian office available if you want one. In-person kickoffs every two months in cool locations across Europe, three days with the whole product and engineering team. All the tokens you need, across all frontier models. Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement. A senior team that ships, across 12+ countries. Our Values We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions. ❤️ Why you will love to join Soda You own the adoption metrics : you decide how we measure adoption and what we do to improve it. Lots of room to improve : we already have enterprise customers and usage data, and we've done very little growth work so far. Your own engineering team : you'll work with dedicated engineers who build agentically, so your ideas get shipped quickly. Be part of a transformation : data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it. Work on your own terms : fully remote, flexible hours, colleagues in 12+ countries. 😡 What you might not love Rapidly changing priorities : our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done. Small numbers : we have relatively few accounts and feedback is slow. If you're used to deciding from consumer-scale data, you may find that frustrating. No playbook : this is the first dedicated growth PM role at Soda. title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer      

 

Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space—we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models.

 

The role

We're looking for a Data Engineer to help build scalable data solutions that serve teams across the business—from data scientists and analysts to AI engineers and product teams. You'll contribute to both the underlying platform and the way data is used in our products, working in a modern, cloud-native environment where privacy, security, and good data practices are part of how we build.

  • Technical Expertise: 3+ years building and shipping production-grade data systems, with strong SQL skills and proficiency in Python or another object-oriented language (Java, Scala etc.)
  • Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure—ideally some exposure to Terraform, Kubernetes, or similar IaC and container orchestration tools. We don't expect deep expertise in all of these, but comfort working in this kind of environment matters.
  • Experience designing data APIs or services that expose data to applications, or a strong interest in working across the analytical/operational boundary.
  • A thoughtful approach to data quality, privacy, and security—you understand that how data is used is as important as how it's moved.
  • Strong collaboration skills and comfort working across teams with different priorities—engineers, data scientists, AI engineers, and product.
  • A pragmatic, curious mindset—you enjoy keeping up with the field and know when to reach for a new tool versus when to stick with what works.
  • Pipeline Management: Hands-on experience with data pipeline tools (Airflow, dbt) and strong ability to optimize for performance and reliability.
  • Quality Focus: Commitment to continuously improving product quality, security, and performance through rigorous testing and code reviews.
  • Documentation: Meticulous approach to creating and maintaining architecture and systems documentation.
  • Problem-Solving: Exceptional analytical skills to troubleshoot complex data issues and implement effective solutions.
  • Independence: Capability to ship medium features independently while contributing to the team's overall objectives.

 

What you’ll be doing in the role 

  • Build and maintain data pipelines that power analytics, ML workloads, and product-facing applications—from internal databases, SaaS sources, and streaming systems through to the teams and services that consume them.
  • Evolve our data platform alongside cloud platform engineers, using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and Kubernetes-based deployments (Argo) to keep the platform scalable, reliable, and self-serve.
  • System Architecture: Design and implement scalable data infrastructure that accommodates our growing data volume and complexity.
  • Develop data services and APIs that expose trusted data to product applications, bridging analytical and operational systems.
  • Own data quality and observability, putting monitoring, testing, and alerting in place so issues are caught early and trust in the data stays high.
  • Partner with AI engineers, data scientists, analysts, and product teams to understand their data needs and design the right solutions—not just the quickest ones.
  • Uphold strong data privacy, security, and compliance practices in everything you build, particularly where data flows into product-facing contexts.
  • Technical Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation of data flows, models, and systems for knowledge sharing.
  • Security and Compliance: Ensure all data systems adhere to security best practices and compliance requirements.

 

Why Prolific is a great place to work

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation—one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity.

Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.

title: IT Systems/Net Work Engineer
description: About Company: Kundlas Consulting Group LLC is a professional consulting firm specializing in construction inspection and compliance services for public infrastructure projects. Our core services include on-site inspection of roadway, bridge, and utility construction to ensure adherence to engineering specifications, safety standards, and contract requirements. We support clients with daily reporting, materials testing coordination, schedule tracking, and quality assurance oversight. Additional services include project management, grants management for federally funded infrastructure and disaster recovery programs. About the Role: The IT Systems/Network Engineer will support the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) READI contract by managing advanced information technology infrastructure and systems that support emergency response, disaster recovery, infrastructure restoration, and continuity of operations. This role provides technical expertise in network architecture, systems administration, cybersecurity, telecommunications, and enterprise IT operations to ensure reliable and secure technology services during mission-critical operations. The IT Systems/Network Engineer will design, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot network and systems infrastructure supporting temporary facilities, emergency operations centers, field deployments, and recovery programs. The position requires close coordination with government stakeholders, cybersecurity personnel, telecommunications providers, and multidisciplinary project teams to ensure secure, resilient, and operationally effective IT environments. Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Network Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Senior-level experience in IT systems engineering, network engineering, systems administration, or related information technology roles. Strong knowledge of network protocols, routing, switching, firewall administration, and enterprise network architecture. Experience administering Windows and Linux server environments and associated enterprise services. Experience implementing, monitoring, and troubleshooting complex network and systems infrastructure. Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, network security controls, and information assurance requirements. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to coordinate with technical teams, leadership, and government stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications: Industry certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP, CompTIA Network+, Security+, CISSP, Microsoft Certified, VMware Certified Professional (VCP), or equivalent credentials. Experience supporting USACE, DoD, FEMA, DHS, or other federal information technology and emergency management programs. Experience supporting emergency operations centers, disaster recovery operations, continuity of operations (COOP), or field-deployed technology systems. Familiarity with cloud computing environments including Microsoft Azure, AWS, or hybrid cloud architectures. Experience with virtualization technologies, network automation, and scripting languages such as PowerShell or Python. Knowledge of NIST cybersecurity frameworks, Risk Management Framework (RMF), and federal information security requirements. Responsibilities: Manage advanced IT infrastructure and systems supporting emergency response, disaster recovery, and recovery operations. Design, configure, maintain, and optimize network infrastructure including routers, switches, firewalls, wireless networks, and telecommunications systems. Administer enterprise server environments, storage systems, virtualization platforms, and supporting applications. Monitor network and system performance, identify operational issues, and implement corrective actions to maintain service availability and reliability. Implement and maintain cybersecurity controls, access management procedures, intrusion detection systems, VPNs, and security monitoring capabilities. Support deployment and operation of temporary communications systems, field technology assets, and emergency operations infrastructure. Develop and maintain network diagrams, system documentation, configuration records, and operational procedures. Support disaster recovery planning, backup management, continuity of operations activities, and system restoration efforts. Coordinate with government personnel, contractors, telecommunications providers, and cybersecurity teams to support operational requirements. Participate in emergency response support activities and provide technical assistance during disaster recovery operations as required. Skills: The ideal candidate must possess advanced expertise in network engineering, systems administration, enterprise IT operations, and infrastructure management to support mission-critical emergency response and recovery activities. Strong knowledge of routing, switching, firewall management, wireless networking, virtualization, server administration, and enterprise architecture is essential for maintaining secure and reliable technology environments. Experience troubleshooting complex network and system issues, implementing cybersecurity controls, and supporting continuity of operations is critical for ensuring operational readiness during disaster response missions. The candidate should demonstrate proficiency in Windows and Linux environments, cloud technologies, virtualization platforms, and network monitoring tools. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities are required to diagnose technical issues, implement effective solutions, and maintain high system availability under demanding operational conditions. Excellent written and verbal communication skills are necessary for preparing technical documentation, coordinating with multidisciplinary teams, and supporting engagement with government stakeholders. Familiarity with NIST standards, federal cybersecurity requirements, and emergency management operations is highly desirable for successful performance under the USACE READI contract.
